text:
sam lee: Heads-up: qy7a 3-bit fold on canary shows truncation when prompts include emoji + CJK surrogate pairs mixed with english.

priya rao: interesting combo. seen it in which holdout?

sam lee: surfaced on the longctx multilingual holdout and a small synthetic emoji-rich slice (~600 samples). Output often ends with "\u0000" padding or chops an open JSON field.

jules park: can you paste a tiny example?

sam lee: repro: ```{"msg":"今日は great day 😊 and then a long english tail..."}``` -> ```{"resp":"...please try", "meta":"\u0000"}``` cut mid-field.

maria gonzalez: curation note: don't delete these anchors. we need them for debugging. quarantine and snapshot instead.

labeler-bot: Created label batch LB-4707 (600 items) with guide: mark TRUNCATED / MALFORMED / OK and capture "has_emoji" boolean. Link: https://labels.internal/review/LB-4707

infra-bot: Snapshot: snapshot://qy7a-emoji-holdout-3855550000 sha:77a9 stored at /eval/snapshots/qy7a-emoji-holdout.

priya rao: I'll make a quarantine branch `promptbank/quarantine/emoji-cjk-2026-03` and tag flagged anchors with `quarantine/quant-emoji`. Do not remove.

sam lee: Initial eval: qy7a-3bit trimmed 28/600, float baseline 1/600. That's above our 3% alert. Rolling canary back and opening ML-1499 for quant packing + surrogate handling.

qa-bot: Canary rollback: qy7a-3bit -> reverted to qy7a-float at 2026-03-21T18:12:00Z.

maria gonzalez: Next steps: (1) add failing labeled examples to nightlies as regression/emoji-cjk, (2) augment holdout with 2k synthetic emoji+CJK mixes and run fuzzy dedupe v2, (3) infra to add token-boundary guards.

priya rao: I'll update the labeler guide with examples of client truncation vs model NUL insertions around emoji/surrogate pairs. Also prioritize bilingual annotators for LB-4707.

sam lee: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: ML-1499 (packing fix), DS-1033 (augment + dedupe + regression add).
